item.title: Brief alcohol ban in Damascus sparks concerns about President al-Sharaa's vision for Syria
item.description: Critics warn new restrictions could signal a shift toward more bans under President Ahmed al-Sharaa given his previous ties to jihadist terror groups.

item.title: Mike Waltz pushes UN resolution to stop Iran mining key global shipping route
item.description: The U.S. is advancing a UN resolution against Iran's actions in the Strait of Hormuz as military forces secure shipping under Project Freedom.
